title: 高頻寬記憶體堆疊整合
summary: 以四階段、24 步深入HBM DRAM 堆疊、TSV、底部邏輯及熱路；每個技術單元分為建模與證據驗證，包含可重算的教學算例、失效辨識及相關工法。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps examine hbm dram stacks, tsvs, base logic and thermal paths. Each technical unit separates modeling from evidence validation, with reproducible teaching examples, failure diagnosis and related methods.
scope: 公開資料支持的原理與工程判讀課；24 步是學習拆解，不是工廠完整 SOP。數值均為明示假設的教學例；實際材料、設備、驗收門檻須依專案規格。不同 HBM 世代的通道、基底晶粒與接合方法不同；本課不把供應商某一 MR-MUF 案例當所有 HBM 的共同配方。
scopeEn: A principles and engineering-interpretation course grounded in public material. The 24 steps are an educational decomposition, not a complete factory SOP. Numbers are labeled hypothetical; actual materials, equipment and acceptance limits require project specifications. HBM generations differ in channels, base dies and bonding; a vendor MR-MUF example is not a universal HBM recipe.

steps.instruction: 沿用上一步模型，但先寫下什麼結果會推翻它。標明未公開設計細節與教學假設。 加入一組對照或重複量測，改變一個會造成混淆的條件，將觀察分為支持、矛盾及仍不足。若只有模擬資料，清楚標成模擬，並指定下一項實物驗證。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous model, first specifying what result would refute it. Label unpublished details and teaching assumptions. Add a control or repeated measurement, vary one confounder, and classify observations as supporting, conflicting or insufficient. Label simulated data explicitly and specify the next physical validation.
steps.observation: 觀察焦點：標明未公開設計細節與教學假設。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
steps.observationEn: Observation focus: Label unpublished details and teaching assumptions. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.
steps.failure: 需排除的錯判：所有 DRAM 層的熱邊界完全相同。本步先檢查「完成堆疊驗收」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到需按世代記錄功能、熱、可靠度與測試覆蓋。所指出的物理限制。
steps.failureEn: Misinterpretation to reject: Every DRAM layer has identical thermal boundaries. First check whether evidence for complete stack acceptance actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: Record generation-specific function, thermal behavior, reliability and coverage.
steps.check: 交付「完成堆疊驗收」的驗收紀錄：包含指定觀察、誤差來源、能支持的結論與一項應暫緩放行的結果。
steps.checkEn: Submit acceptance evidence for complete stack acceptance: the specified observation, error sources, supported conclusion and one hold condition.
